en.headline: FEHD launches second phase of Operation Skynet targeting public markets
en.dek: The two-week operation will inspect markets for pest and hygiene issues after the first phase focused on supermarkets and restaurants.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department has launched the second phase of Operation Skynet, targeting public markets across the territory.

The department said the first phase, which ran for two weeks from September 30 and focused on supermarkets, restaurants and other food premises, had concluded with multiple notices, warnings and prosecutions issued for pest and hygiene problems.

The second phase, also lasting two weeks, will continue the crackdown on pest infestation and hygiene issues in public markets to safeguard food safety and environmental hygiene. Officers will take immediate enforcement action if irregularities are found.

zh.headline: 食環署展開「天網行動」第二階段 巡查全港街市
zh.dek: 為期兩周的行動針對街市害蟲及衞生問題，第一階段針對超市及食肆已結束並發出多項通知及檢控。
body: 食物環境衞生署已展開「天網行動」第二階段，針對全港街市進行巡查。
署方表示，第一階段自9月30日起為期兩周，集中檢查超市、食肆及其他食物業處所，已就害蟲及衞生問題發出多項通知、警告並提出檢控，現已結束。
第二階段同樣為期兩周，將繼續打擊街市的害蟲及衞生問題，以保障食物安全及環境衞生。如發現違規，人員會立即執法。
